{{SameName|Overgrowth|[[Overgrowth (Solar Eclipse)|Solar Eclipse]] • [[Overgrowth (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date = 26th of January 2022|event = [[Solar Eclipse Event]]}} {{For|[[Ent]]|[[Lurker]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Overgrowth |image1 = overgrowth.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Foggy Forest|Solar Eclipse Night II]] |first_wave_appearance = 3 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]90 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Overgrowth''' was the second enemy that appeared in the second night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. Currently, it can only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had higher health than the [[Shroogma]] but was slower than it. ==Appearance== The '''Overgrowth''' was a living, humanoid tree. Its body was made out of brown and dark brown wood, with a crown made of bark and a single carved leg. It had vines covering its body. It had neon pale green eyes. It walked with a slightly hunched back. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in the [[Solar Eclipse Event]] is listed instead. *Cheap towers with high DPS, such as the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Hunter]] or [[Scout]] can deal with this. **For the [[Crook Boss]] and [[Scout]], you can use their {{Color|Golden}} skins for better performance. *Since these are slow and spawn in groups, towers capable of hitting multiple enemies, like the [[Gladiator]], are very effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseOvergrowth1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Executioner - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Overgrowth''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Overgrowth''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyOvergrowthIconIG.png|'''Overgrowth''' on its icon. OvergrowthBanlands.png|'''Overgrowth''' on [[Banlands]] map. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Overgrowth''' was based on the [[w:c:lotr:Ents|Ent]] from ''The Lord of the Rings''. ==Update History== *'''6 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]b **'''Overgrowth''' added. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Overgrowth''' removed. *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **'''Overgrowth''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Lurker]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. {{FoggyForest|[[Shroogma]]|Wave 1|Overgrowth|Wave 3|[[Ghost (Solar Eclipse)|Ghost]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Overgrowth}}
